test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lives**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage talks about work being central to human existence.
 
• The first blank requires a noun that reflects what revolves around work in humans.
 
• "**Lives**" fits perfectly as it denotes human existence, which logically revolves around work according to the passage.
 
• Other options like "mortals" or "creatures" refer to humans or beings in general but do not fit the idea of what revolves around work.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**
